title: Head of Operations / COO
text:
### **About the Role**

A small, early-stage AI company serving manufacturers is seeking a Head of Operations / COO to work closely with the founders. You will own day-to-day business operations and help build scalable customer delivery and supply chain processes.

### **What You'll Do**

* Lead end-to-end operations, including customer onboarding, order execution, supplier and carrier coordination, and issue resolution.
* Build processes, metrics, and playbooks that help a lean team serve more manufacturers.
* Partner with engineering to identify operational workflows that AI agents should automate.
* Manage supplier and freight operations, vendor relationships, and service quality.
* Hire and lead the operations team as the business grows.
* Work with the founders on planning, finance, and company priorities.

### **What We're Looking For**

* Six to ten years of relevant experience, including senior operations leadership as a Head of Operations, COO, VP or Director of Operations, or in a similar role.
* Hands-on experience in supply chain, procurement, logistics, or manufacturing operations.
* Experience at an early-stage startup or on a small team, with the ability to build processes from the ground up and stay hands-on.
* Strong numerical, systems, and process-design skills.
* Experience in CPG, food, supplements, cosmetics, chemicals, or related manufacturing, or in freight brokerage or 3PL operations, is helpful.
* Past founder or early startup experience is a plus.

### **Location**

On-site in San Francisco, California, five days per week. Candidates may relocate within the United States.
